title: REAL Provider-Issued Credentials
subtitle: Issued by world-class corporations and universities — not by Zuyini
issuerRule: Every credential in this section is awarded by the named provider under that provider's own assessment or completion rules. Zuyini curates, verifies and maps the opportunity; it does not re-label its own certificate as the provider's credential.

taxonomy.label: Provider Certification
taxonomy.desc: Provider explicitly calls it a certification and requires an exam/assessment.

taxonomy.label: Verified Micro-Credential
taxonomy.desc: Provider-verified applied skill, lab assessment, skill badge or superbadge.

taxonomy.label: University Course Certificate
taxonomy.desc: University/course-team certificate earned after defined coursework or assessment.

taxonomy.label: Completion Certificate / Badge
taxonomy.desc: Provider record of successful course completion or achievement.

audit: Google Skills – Professional Agentic Architect Certification path: this is an excellent preparation path, but the professional certification exam itself is not free. Google currently lists the beta exam at $120, a 40% discount from the $200 retail price. The Google Skills Starter tier is no-cost and currently includes 35 free credits each month, limited hands-on labs and skill badges. Zuyini therefore lists the free badge/preparation layer separately and does not count the Professional Agentic Architect certification as a $0 certification.

sections.label: Completion Proof
sections.title: Free Completion Proof
sections.subtitle: OpenLearn + HP LIFE + Kaggle
sections.intro: World-class learning with provider-issued proof of completion.

cards.heading: The Open University — OpenLearn
cards.body: Nearly 1,000 free courses. The Open University says every OpenLearn course can earn a free Statement of Participation, and some courses additionally award a free OU-branded digital badge after quiz requirements. These are valuable CPD/learning records but do not carry formal university credit.

cards.heading: HP LIFE — HP Foundation
cards.body: 30+ free business and digital-skills courses. HP LIFE states that its courses are free and that learners receive a free Certificate of Completion each time they finish a course. Current categories include Communication, Digital Business Skills, Entrepreneurship, Finance, Marketing and Professional Development.

cards.heading: Kaggle Learn — Completion Certificates
cards.body: Kaggle says learners earn a completion certificate for every Learn course they finish. Use these as practical data/ML evidence, especially when paired with a notebook or competition project. Popular skill areas include Python, Pandas, SQL, Intro to Machine Learning, Intermediate ML, Data Visualization, Deep Learning, Computer Vision and Feature Engineering.

sections.note: On your resume or LinkedIn, use the credential's exact name — for example “Microsoft Applied Skills: Generate reports with AI research agents,” not “Microsoft Certified AI Engineer.” The same goes for an OpenLearn Statement of Participation, a Kaggle completion certificate, an AWS badge or a Salesforce Superbadge: list it as what it is, not as a professional certification.

sections.label: Role Stacking
sections.title: Credential-to-Role Stacks
sections.subtitle: Pair external proof with Zuyini role mastery and a portfolio artifact
sections.intro: A good stack isn't random: start with your target role, add one or two credentials that prove you know its actual tools or domain, then finish with a capstone that shows you can apply the skill.

stacks.title: AI / Agent Engineer
stacks.path: IBM AI Fundamentals → IBM Build an AI Agent → Microsoft Applied Skills → Google Skills badges → Zuyini AI Engineer / Agent Mastery.

stacks.title: Software / Full-Stack Engineer
stacks.path: Harvard CS50x or CS50P → University of Helsinki Full Stack Open → Zuyini Software Developer / Full-Stack Engineer.

stacks.title: Data / ML
stacks.path: Kaggle Learn certificates → IBM Data Fundamentals → Zuyini Data Scientist / ML Engineer → portfolio notebook or deployed model.

stacks.title: Cloud / Platform
stacks.path: AWS Educate badges → IBM Cloud Computing Fundamentals → Zuyini Cloud / Platform Engineer → deployed service + SLO/runbook.

stacks.title: Cybersecurity
stacks.path: Harvard CS50 Cybersecurity → IBM Cybersecurity Fundamentals → Zuyini Security Engineer → authorized threat model / lab evidence.

stacks.title: Marketing / Growth
stacks.path: Google Ads + Google Analytics certifications → HubSpot Digital / Inbound certifications → Zuyini Digital Marketing / Growth PM.

stacks.title: CRM / Agentforce
stacks.path: Salesforce Trailhead Superbadges → Zuyini CRM Engineer / Salesforce Agentforce path → hands-on automation / agent artifact.

stacks.title: Business / Entrepreneurship
stacks.path: HP LIFE certificates → HubSpot Inbound / Sales → Zuyini Mini MBA / Entrepreneurship / Business Management capstone.

auditStandard: We link to each provider's own official page, not a reseller or aggregator.
We confirm the credential itself is free, not just the training that leads up to it.
We label every credential by its real type — certification, micro-credential, course certificate or badge — and never blur the four.
We flag hidden costs up front: subscriptions, lab credits, paid product tiers or exam fees.
We re-check every link and price before each update to this directory.
We use the provider's exact credential name — never a rebranded or embellished version.
We pair every credential with real hands-on proof, so this stays skills-first, not badge-first.
